test_LogisticRegression_solvers: test that LogisticRegression solvers converge to the same result on classification data
test_LogisticRegressionCV_hyperparameter: test LogisticRegressionCV cross-validated hyperparameter selection with multiple C and l1_ratio values
test_sample_class_weight_equivalence: test that class_weight and sample_weight produce equivalent LogisticRegression coefficients
test_warm_start_convergence: test that warm_start LogisticRegression converges to the same solution as non-warm-start
test_elastic_net_penalty: test that elasticnet penalty with saga solver produces different coefficients from pure l1 and l2
test_sparse_matrix_support: test that sparse and dense input matrices produce consistent LogisticRegression results
test_multiclass_multinomial: test that multinomial LogisticRegression gives better accuracy than one-vs-rest on multiclass data
test_solver_convergence_warnings: test that LogisticRegression raises ConvergenceWarning when max_iter is insufficient
test_LogisticRegressionCV_class_weights: test LogisticRegressionCV with class_weight balanced and custom weight dictionaries
test_logistic_regression_path_coefs: test that _logistic_regression_path returns correct coefficient arrays for multiple C values
